tipRead: Read the sentence and say its meaning
tipComp: Read the meaning and say it in English
tipShadow: Listen, then say it the same way
tipRecord: Read the meaning and record it in English (show sentence: A)
tooShort: That was too short, so the recording was dropped.
micNote: Find a quiet spot and speak clearly near the microphone.
shadowMiss: Not quite. You have up to 3 tries. Say it again.
shadowSilent: Nothing was heard. Speak loudly and clearly.
shadowUnsupported: This browser cannot recognise speech. Open it in Chrome to check what you said.
reviewAsk: You finished this step. Start it again?
noRecord: Recording is closed after the deadline. You can still listen.
preview: Preview · progress and recordings are not saved
keys: Space: go · Esc: stop · R: once more
